count.description: Number of teams (for singles or pairs events, one entry is one team).

roster.description: The player slots in every team, e.g. Man 1, Man 2, Woman. One slot for singles, two for a doubles pair.

slot.description: Short id such as m1, m2, w1, p1.

label.description: Name shown to people, such as Man 1.

formation.description: balanced_draw: players drawn from pots by level so teams are even. random_draw: fully random. organizer_picks: teams are entered as they are.

games.description: The games played when two teams meet, in order. Each lists the roster slots who play it: one slot for singles, two for doubles.

label.description: Such as Men's doubles or Mixed doubles 1.

ifLevel.description: What happens when both teams win the same number of games. none: cannot happen (odd number of games). decider_game: one extra game. total_points: more points across the games wins. draw: the tie is drawn (groups only).

pointsTo.description: Points to win a game, such as 15 or 21.

winBy.description: 1, or 2 for win by two clear points.

cap.description: Score at which the next point wins, such as 30 for games to 21. 0 means no cap.

count.description: Number of groups. 1 is a single league of everyone. 0 means no group stage (straight knockout).

rounds.description: 1: everyone in a group plays each other once. 2: twice (home and away). 0 when there are no groups.

playoffs.description: Playoff brackets after the groups, such as a Cup for the top two of each group and a Plate for the rest. Empty if the league or groups decide everything.

format.description: knockout: single elimination. ipl: 4 teams, Qualifier 1 (1v2), Eliminator (3v4), Qualifier 2, Final. final_only: the top 2 play one final.

positions.description: Group finishing places that go into this bracket, such as [1, 2]. Empty when there is no group stage (all teams enter).

minutesPerGame.description: Typical minutes for one game including change-over.

notes.description: Each assumption made for something the description did not say, in one short sentence.
